comparison.objective: Perform an insulin pen safety shot and dial a 12-unit dose using the dose window.
comparison.physical_skill: Needle-up orientation, button actuation, fine rotary dialing, and visual/state verification.
comparison.success_condition: A valid 2-unit safety shot precedes an accurately indicated 12-unit dose without unsafe needle handling.
comparison.reason: This tests ordered medical-device operation and dial-state reading, not notch fracture, hammer regulation, or fragment collection.
